detailed_description: The Regex Visualizer turns a JavaScript regular expression pattern into a simple SVG diagram and can test the pattern against sample text. Enter a pattern, add an optional test string, then visualize the result to see the generated diagram and a list of matches. The diagram can be exported as SVG or PNG. The tool validates patterns with the browser JavaScript RegExp engine, so behavior may differ from PCRE, Python, or other regex engines.
usage_steps: Enter a JavaScript regex pattern in the pattern field.
Optionally enter sample text in the test string area.
Click Visualize to generate the diagram and match results.
Review any validation error if the pattern cannot be parsed.
Export the generated diagram as SVG or PNG if needed.
Use Clear to reset the pattern, test string, diagram, and matches.
usage_examples: Visualize a simple email-like pattern before adding it to a form validation note.
Check which parts of a sample log line match a JavaScript regex.
Export a small regex diagram for documentation or a code review comment.
Clear and compare a few alternative patterns while learning regex syntax.
